name: cast-framework
description: Highlighting, navigation and prop-aware completion for CastFramework views (.cast.php): component tags, docblock props and types, Ctrl+click to open a component's file.

cast.componentsPath.markdownDescription: Folder(s) with the component files, relative to the workspace folder. Used for Ctrl+click on `<Component />` tags. When `config/view.php` sets `components`, that folder is used as well.

cast.viewsPath.markdownDescription: Folder of the views, relative to the workspace folder (for `__includes('layouts.header')`, `views('home.home')`, `Component('btns.add')`).

cast.extension.markdownDescription: The extension of view and component files that use the engine syntax.

cast.diagnostics.markdownDescription: Problems in component tags, for components that document their props: unknown prop, missing required prop, a value outside the documented list, deprecated component or prop. `hint` shows faint dots only.

cast.propCase.markdownDescription: How prop names are written when completed: `hasLabel`, `has-label` or `has_label` (the engine treats all three the same).

cast.autoIndent.markdownDescription: Keep the indentation right while typing in `.cast.php` files: after Enter, and when a line starts with a closing tag, `<?php endif ?>`, `@endif` or `@else`. `Format Document` and `Cast: Fix indentation` re-indent a whole view.
